aed5009ee475.normalization: Each train/test example is mean-centered across features and normalized to centered unit RMS. Replacement noise swaps each feature with normalized-scale uniform noise with probability p. Additive Gaussian noise uses (1 - p) * clean + p * noise. Noisy training examples are not normalized again.

fit: Equal-weight OLS on folder mean log SNR; descriptive, no independence-based p-values
